description.en: The region ID of the new node.

description.zh:
资源场景所属的地域ID。

您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The region ID of the resource scenario.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源场景ID。

关于如何获取资源场景ID，请参见[ListTemplateScratches](~~363050~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource scenario.

For more information about how to query the IDs of resource scenarios, see [ListTemplateScratches](~~363050~~).

description.zh: 生成模板类型，支持生成ROS和Terraform类型的模板，默认为ROS。
description.en: The type of the template that Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) generates. ROS can generate templates of the ROS and Terraform types. Default value: ROS.

descriptions.zh:
本文将提供一个示例，在杭州地域为资源纳管类型的资源场景`ts-aa9c62feab844a6b****`生成模板。

> 资源探查类型的资源场景不支持生成模板。
descriptions.en:
In this example, a template is generated for a resource management scenario that resides in the China (Hangzhou) region. The ID of the resource scenario is `ts-aa9c62feab844a6b****`.

> You cannot generate a template for a resource detection scenario.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros generate-template-by-scratch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-scratch-id ts-aa9c62feab844a6b0000 --provision-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-type ROS --region cn-hangzhou
